p=Path('programs/task-49d7062c.py')

fn='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    motif = None
    for row in grid:
        for i in range(len(row) - 4):
            vals = row[i:i+5]
            if all(v != bg for v in vals):
                motif = vals[:]
                break
        if motif is not None:
            break
    if motif is None:
        return out
    marker = 6 if any(6 in row for row in grid) else 7
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v == marker:
                for k, color in enumerate(motif):
                    x = c - 2 + k
                    if 0 <= x < len(row):
                        out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(fn)
print('saved', p, 'bytes', p.stat().st_size)
